generation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. A production pixel-art wall sprite sheet with EXACTLY TWELVE complete walls.

Image 1 is the geometric EDIT TARGET, a 4-column by 3-row sheet of flat wall templates. Preserve its1536x2048 canvas, all 12 positions, rectangular masks, top/body proportions and cap pad locations exactly. Paint INSIDE its existing silhouettes, do not resize/rearrange. Image 2 is the USER-SELECTED finished wall design: retain its raised square cap, shallow bevel, stone block/wood panel construction, restrained weathering, palette, pixel technique and lighting. Images3-5 are approved temple, wreck, and milk floor textures; their quiet, low-saturation sparse pixel texture is the overall style standard.

LAYOUT: four columns are Temple gray-blue stone; Wreck muted brown wood; Abyss gray-indigo stone; Milk beige sandstone. Three rows are three distinct variants of each SAME theme. Exactly3 per theme,12 total. All three in a column use the SAME base palette, brightness, border color, central square pad geometry, internal masonry/wood divisions and outer shape. Vary only placement of small sparse wear patches, short wood grain marks, and restrained thin cracks similar to the selected reference. Row1 mostly intact with subtle scuffs, row2 different sparse scuffs and light weathering, row3 a few small thin weathering cracks. Do not make progressive damage states or collapsing walls. Each is a full normal wall. No large emblem, no chips in the silhouette, no glowing parts.

HARD DIMENSIONS: every wall exactly240x528 in this sheet, equivalent to native80x176 at3x. Upper cap240x240 = square; lower attached front face240x288 =1.2height/width. No isometric projection or trapezoids. x starts144,480,816,1152; y starts152,760,1368. Cap/body split always exactly y+240. Bottoms y+528. Central small square pad108x108 stays inside cap. Width stays240 from top to bottom, no side overhang, no taper, no gap at join. Keep template opaque bounds unchanged. ALL 12 use identical dimensions. Preserve structural ratios; this art must fit the game with UNIFORM scaling only, no later stretching.

Edges are thin matching-material colors, not black outlines. Cap noticeably lighter than body with shallow top-left lighting. Crisp pixel clusters matching floors, no photorealism, smooth blur or noisy speckles. Surrounding background fully transparent outside each rectangle; NO haze, glow, shadows, gradient, vignette or floor. No title, no text, no numbering, no grid lines. Output just the 12 separate wall sprites in the template's exact arrangement.

notes: 上传原件的像素内容和此前生成稿并非逐像素相同；上传原件为唯一选定版本。
